review_summary: The junior differential captured the key lipid abnormality and most relevant comorbidities, but probabilities needed adjustment (FH under‑estimated, polygenic under‑emphasized). Critical data gaps (family history, thyroid panel, medication list, renal work‑up, BMI) were correctly identified. Overall the reasoning is solid, with an overall confidence of 84 %.
